statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir_name=$(basename "$cwd"); status="$(printf '\033[96m%s\033[0m' "$dir_name")"; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && status+=" $(printf '\033[2;37m[%s]\033[0m' "$branch")"; git_status=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$git_status" ]; then modified=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^ M' || true); untracked=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^??' || true); staged=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^[AMDRC]' || true); indicators=""; [ "$modified" -gt 0 ] && indicators+="​"; [ "$untracked" -gt 0 ] && indicators+="​"; [ "$staged" -gt 0 ] && indicators+="​"; [ -n "$indicators" ] && status+=" $(printf '\033[38;5;218m%s\033[0m' "$indicators")"; fi; fi; [ -n "$VIRTUAL_ENV" ] && status+=" $(printf '\033[2;37m%s\033[0m' "$(basename "$VIRTUAL_ENV")")"; echo "$status"
